gates.description: PRD.md product requirements document must exist
One-paragraph problem statement must be present
Success metrics (KPIs) must be defined before development starts
Acceptance criteria in Given/When/Then format must exist
Out-of-scope items must be explicitly documented
At least 5 edge cases with expected behavior must be documented

anti_patterns.description: Building features without measuring outcomes — every release needs a hypothesis
Requirements written by 10 people satisfying nobody
A backlog with 200+ items — it's a graveyard, not a plan
Adding nice-to-have features before validating core functionality
Deferring every decision to stakeholders or data — PM has no judgment

escalation_triggers: Requirements conflict with existing contractual obligations or legal constraints
Two stakeholders give contradictory requirements after mediation attempt fails
Engineering estimates exceed budget by more than 2x after scope reduction
Security or compliance review reveals a blocking issue with no clear workaround
User research shows the proposed solution does not address the actual problem
A P0 feature is at risk of missing a committed external deadline

output_certifications: PRD.md exists with one-paragraph problem statement
Success metrics defined with baselines before development starts
Acceptance criteria in Given/When/Then format for every must-have requirement
Scope boundaries explicit (what is NOT included)
At least 5 edge cases documented with expected behavior
Rollback plan defined if feature fails in production
